records.text: Owens said Bill Ackman invested 900 million dollars in Howard Hughes Holdings in May 2025 and returned as executive chairman.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Bill Ackman made a $900 million investment into Howard Hughes Holding Incorporated, returning him back to that executive chair position.

verification.notes: Howard Hughes Holdings' SEC filing records the May 5, 2025 sale of nine million shares to Pershing Square Holdco for 900 million dollars and the associated governance and strategy change. The filing identifies Ackman's Pershing Square as the investor and the transaction returned him to executive-chairman leadership.

sources.title: Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. Form 8-K, May 5, 2025
sources.relevance: Primary SEC filing for the 900 million dollar transaction and governance change.
